description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class LeaveAllocate within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. The class manages leave request events, holding references to leave request data, workflow state, and the user performing the action. It provides methods to access detailed leave information, workflow, and user information.

classes.name: LeaveAllocate
classes.description: An abstract class representing a leave allocation event, encapsulating leave request data, workflow state, and performing user information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes leave request, workflow, and performer properties.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequest
methods.description: Returns a detailed leave request, converting a simple leave request to its detailed form if necessary.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the associated workflow state machine.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the leave allocation event.
